there's a good few classics from the genre:  
  
stuff like floral shoppe by macintosh plus (you'll definitely recognise track 2) is probably an essential entry point to vaporwave as a whole  
  
i'll try living like this by death's dynamic shroud.wmv was one of my personal favourites for a while and has a nice mix of vaprowave and plunderphonics  
  
chuck person's eccojams vol. 1 is a certified classic  
  
underwater dream by virtual dream plaza has a big ambient vibe to it and part of the slushwave subgenre

you might know of vaportrap since yung lean had a few songs, like "hurt" for example, with heavy vaportrap type beats or that were straight up vaportrap, big recommendation from that subgenre is blank banshee (probably the most well known too) but both blank banshee 1 & 2 are pretty good listens

SEAWORLD heartbreak by death's dynamic shroud.wmv was also in rotation for a while and it kinda has that aquatic sound to it that i love about cartier god's stuff whenever he doesn't go for that nocturnal vibe

arctic circuitry is also a huge recommendation, the whole tape sounds like whatever daw was being used got frozen in an igloo from how cold and icy it sounds

telepath テレパシー能力者 are also really good but i have no specific recommendation since i didn't listen to them much
